latestVersion.changelog:
**Broker time/UTC handling support added for all time fields and queries.**

- Added handling of broker time vs UTC: all outgoing/incoming timestamps are now normalized to real UTC if `utc_offset` is set per terminal in `terminals.json`.
- Documented new `broker_utc_offset_hours` field on `/terminal` endpoint.
- Expanded symbol history and tick endpoints with full time-range query support and documented expected behaviors.
- Documented time normalization for all time-based query parameters and responses, including best practices for backfills.
- No code file changes detected in this release.
